questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The average of 11 results is 60. If the average of the first 6 results is 58 and that of the last 6 is 63, what is the 6th result?
questions.solution: Total of 11 = 660. First 6 = 348. Last 6 = 378. 6th = 348 + 378 - 660 = 66. Wait, 348+378=726. 726-660=66. Not in options... The 6th result is counted in both groups. Sum of first 6 + sum of last 6 = total + 6th (since 6th is counted twice). So 6th = 348 + 378 - 660 = 66. This doesn't match any option.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The average of three numbers is 40. The first number is twice the second and the second is thrice the third. What is the first number?
questions.solution: Let third = x, second = 3x, first = 6x. (6x + 3x + x)/3 = 40 → 10x = 120 → x = 12. First = 72
